title: IMU_CARRIER L 40.28 x 14.5: IMU pack TVS, reverse isolation and the 16 wire pads of the IMU cable, RP2040-Zero and BNO085
note: W2 PCB-SB2. Two-layer carrier on the printed IMU carrier: the IMU cable cores land on J518 next to the TVS U552 and the reverse-isolation diode D502; J320/J321 and J322 take the 26 AWG leads up to the RP2040-Zero and the BNO085 on their 13 mm standoffs. The 40.28 x 6.0 strip of imu_pack.json cannot hold the 16 W2 GR-4 pads at 4 mm pitch, so the outline adds an arm under the RP2040-Zero (build/kicad/boards/IMU_CARRIER/contract-proposal.json; OPEN for the IMU lineage). CI/model output only; not a fabrication release; IMU-01 and the pack gates stay OPEN.

layers.source: final-plan.json PCB-SB2 / A-PCB-10 decision: 2-layer 1.6 mm JLC standard for the small boards; decision 'Малі плати II: шари й мідь (W2 PCB-SB2)' in build/15

plan.F.Cu: all parts; E5_IMU5V class PWR1A 0.35 mm (IMU_CARRIER.kicad_pro, pcb/generated/netclasses.json); E5_IMU_VIN scripted 0.4 mm (class SCRIPTED_VIN); signals; GND pour

rules_note: The rules live in the committed project file: the HATCH/ENC set (minimum 0.15 / 0.15, via 0.6 / 0.3, copper-edge 0.3, hole-hole 0.5, hole clearance 0.25, text 1.0 / 0.15) with the Default class narrowed to track 0.2 / clearance 0.15 for this dense one-layer-of-parts board (JLC 2-layer floor 0.10 / 0.10, fab_floor), plus the board net classes named in layers.plan. pcb/rules/jlc-2l.kicad_dru is not attached: pcb/board_gen.py refuses a non-null rules_file (validate_spec).

parts.anchor_source: strip, lower row, rotated 180: pads 1 IMU_TX (20.0), 2 IMU_RX (16.0), 3 CS_N (12.0), 4 WAKE_N (8.0) - TX/RX towards the arm, CS/WAKE under their J322 pads; pad 4 box 3.15 from the H1 axis (keepout 3.0)
strip, lower row: RP2040-Zero supply leads (E5_IMU_VIN, GND, 3V3), pads x 23.5-31.5 (courtyard 22.0-33.0)
strip, upper row, rotated 180: pads 1 3V3 (24.6), 2 GND (20.6), 3 CS_N (16.6), 4 WAKE_N (12.6), 5 3V3 (8.6) under the BNO085
arm, lowest row: the four IMU cable cores (E5_IMU5V, GND, IMU_TX, IMU_RX), pads x 26.5-38.5; 3.5 clear of the H2 keepout
arm, top band: reverse isolation, anode (pad 2, E5_IMU5V) towards U552
arm, top band: TVS on IMU_TX / IMU_RX / E5_IMU5V next to J518
strip right of J322: 10 uF on E5_IMU_VIN beside the scripted VIN lane (pad 1 (29.55, 4.6))
tongue above J322 pad 3: CS_N pull-up, pad 1 (CS_N) down, pad 2 (3V3) up
tongue above J322 pad 4: WAKE_N pull-up, pad 1 (WAKE_N) down, pad 2 (3V3) up
tongue above J322 pad 5: 100 nF on E3_IMU3V3, pad 1 (3V3) up, pad 2 GND down

post_route_zones.why: GND pour, solid pad connection (no thermal spokes starved between the 4 mm wire pads)

edge_keepout.why: rule-area strips (half-width 0.2) on every outline edge keep router copper 0.35 mm off the edge, above the project copper-to-edge 0.3 (as pcb/boards/PWR_B.json edge_keepout)

heights_note: D502 SMA 2.3, U552 SOT-23-6 1.45, 0805 1.35, 0603 0.95/0.55 (package outline assumptions until the datasheets are read); wire pads 1.5 = solder joint of a 26 AWG lead (assumption)

router.why: E5_IMU_VIN is scripted and locked (class SCRIPTED_VIN, not autorouted); fan-out pre-pass off: on PWR_B it escaped SMD pins with necked-down stubs and dangling vias (pcb/boards/PWR_B.json router.why)
